Container.Name: apt-cacher-ultra
Container.Overview:
Caching proxy for Debian and Ubuntu package downloads (apt). The first machine that installs a package fetches it from the internet; every other machine gets it from your server. A maintained replacement for apt-cacher-ng: same port 3142 and the same client settings, so existing clients keep working.
Checks every file against the repository's signed index, and keeps serving cached packages when a mirror is slow or down.
Clients: put Acquire::http::Proxy "http://SERVER-IP:3142"; into /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/01proxy. HTTPS repositories are not cached unless their sources line is changed to http://HTTPS///host/path.
The config is written to /config/config.toml on the first start; edit it there and restart. The status page and Prometheus metrics are on port 6789.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: apt-cacher-ng apt cache proxy debian ubuntu deb package mirror acng squid-deb-proxy approx
Container.Requires: Clients need one line in their apt config, see the README.

Config.Name: Proxy port
Config.Description: Port the apt clients use: Acquire::http::Proxy "http://SERVER-IP:3142";

Config.Name: Status page port
Config.Description: Status page, /metrics (Prometheus) and /healthz. Set an admin password below if other people can reach it.

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: Downloaded packages and the cache database. A cache pool is faster than the array.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: config.toml, written with defaults on the first start.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Optional. Protects the status page with a login (user below). Empty = no login.

Config.Name: Admin user
Config.Description: Login name for the status page when a password is set.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the cache files.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the cache files.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Time zone for log timestamps, e.g. Europe/Berlin.
